title: Forgiving LLM Parsing on Ticket Open
description: The llm string should be more forgiving during ticket open. For example, 'claude-opus-4-5-20251101' should resolve to 'opus-4-5'. This should be achieved by slugifying the input and checking if any allowed LLM is a substring of it.
summary: The LLM and UI parsing during ticket open, reopen, and progress is now robust against different string formats (e.g., dots vs hyphens) by slugifying both the input and the allowed list candidates before performing substring matches.
